name: agy-supervised-development
description: Codex-governed development with Sol High pre-plan review, Herdr as the sole AGY runtime, AGY as the primary writer, and Git-backed independent verification.

interface.shortDescription: Codex governs; Herdr runs; AGY builds; Git proves.
interface.longDescription: A serial supervised-development workflow. Codex owns Shape/Spec/Slice and the executable plan; GPT-5.6 Sol High may review that plan before PLAN FROZEN; every AGY execution then runs through Herdr; Codex independently reviews and verifies repository/runtime evidence before acceptance.
capabilities: Shape, specify, and slice executable plans
Review executable plans with GPT-5.6 Sol High before implementation
Run every AGY writer through Herdr
Preserve Antigravity session identity through Herdr integration
Run Three-Axis Review and independent verification
Use Chrome DevTools MCP for applicable browser runtime verification
interface.defaultPrompt: Use AGY Supervised Development. Build a Codex-owned executable plan, use the default Sol High plan review gate unless I explicitly opt out, freeze the plan, then run AGY only through Herdr and keep all review, verification, and acceptance Codex-owned.
